body:
Subject: PR #1934 — STORY-1216 builder image + incremental mirror builds

STORY-1216 is up as PR #1934 (rebased on main, independent of #1933; touches .gitlab-ci.yml, ci/Dockerfile, docs/gitlab-ci-runner.md only). Measured on the mirror: cold verify 1271 s -> warm 903 s; compile is now ~5 min with deps fully reused, the rest is the 6530-test suite (314 s in nextest) plus the MCP shell tests. The "<10 min warm" acceptance is not met yet; the follow-up (split build/test jobs or trim verify) is noted on the story. Runner host config is already applied on this box. Joe asked for this one to go first.
